description: Defines the interface for a UDP Datagram Server Socket class, including methods for socket initialization, data transmission, multicast management, buffer sizing, and thread safety.

classes.name: DatagramServerSocket
classes.description: An interface class for a UDP socket server, providing methods for socket operations and multicast management.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Initializes the socket as a server listening at the specified address.

methods.name: RecvFrom
methods.description: Receives data from the socket along with sender address information.

methods.name: SendTo
methods.description: Sends data to a specified recipient address.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the receive buffer size for the socket.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets the send buffer size for the socket.

methods.name: AllowAddressReuse
methods.description: Allows sharing the local address with other processes.

methods.name: AllowBroadcast
methods.description: Enables sending and receiving broadcast packets.

methods.name: AllowAddressSharingForMulticast
methods.description: Allows sharing the local address for multicast.

methods.name: SetMulticastInterface
methods.description: Sets the network interface for multicast traffic.

methods.name: SetMulticastTimeToLive
methods.description: Sets the TTL for multicast packets.

methods.name: SetMulticastLoopbackMode
methods.description: Enables or disables loopback for multicast packets.

methods.name: SetDiffServCodePoint
methods.description: Sets the Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP) for packets.

methods.name: DetachFromThread
methods.description: Resets thread affinity for thread-safety checks.
